profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Salesforce
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience working on internal developer tools in Python and JavaScript, writing POSIX-compliant Shell scripts and working with large-scale distributed systems in AWS and Linux/Unix environments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
– Worked on internal developer tools with Python, Java, along with automation to assist debugging, reducing investigation time for critical incidents across distributed systems relying on Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL, and MySQL.
– Designed and implemented an LLM-powered debugging agent (Apex, SOQL, SOSL) that proactively analyzed logs and correlated related bugs, to reduce production troubleshooting efforts.
– Optimized security validation checks, lowering user access verification time and minimizing system timeouts.
– Provided technical guidance to engineers on system debugging techniques and delivered multiple department-wide demos, improving team throughput, productivity, and reliability or web applications.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
– Developed automation scripts for Linux systems in Python, Bourne & Bash Shell scripts, and Apex to detect and resolve data integrity issues, cutting team manual debugging efforts.
– Improved onboarding experience by building local debugging environments with Docker, NPM, Bazel, Maven, and Yarn, reducing ramp-up time for new engineers.
– Supported investigations across AWS-based distributed systems, ensuring timely issue resolution for millions of users.
– Partnered with platform teams to enhance service monitoring, logging, and alerting, boosting operational visibility.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
– Migrated on-premise data warehouse to AWS, Azure, and Oracle Autonomous DW, improving scalability and reliability.
– Developed and maintained ETL pipelines for real-time data synchronization, reducing processing time and improving SLA compliance.
– Provided on-call support for production ETL failures, ensuring business continuity.

courses.name: Designing and Developing Relational and NoSQL Database

projects.description: Processes images locally to ensure no information leaves the device.
